correctness.rationale: Using h_k²=Γ(α+2)Γ(k+1)/Γ(k+α+2), the two crossed adjoint products have support on columns e_{bq} and common output e_{aq} for a=m/g,b=n/g. Exact coefficient κ_q=1_{g|q}w_n(q/g)w_m(q/g)−w_m(bq)w_n(aq) diagonalizes K*K. For g>1, nonmultiples g approach modulus (mn)^−(α+1)/2 and multiples approach zero, proving exact modulus essential spectrum and essential norm. For g=1, first-order log-gamma expansion gives κ_q=c/q+O(q^-2) with c=δ(δ+1)(mn)^−δ/2(1−1/m)(1−1/n)/2; counting inversion gives Ns_N→c, sharp p>1 Schatten threshold and logarithmic trace coefficient. At α=0 an exact numerator identity gives the displayed rational closed form. Independently recalculated the cancellation coefficient and the support divisibility, inspected 6966-assertion verifier; numerical checks alone do not establish limits.

value.rationale: The monomial pair is a natural complete arithmetic test family on the standard Bergman scales. The gcd transition for compact cancellation between individually noncompact products, exact essential norm on complementary branch and nonzero weak-trace endpoint are mathematically motivated operator-ideal invariants, not finite numerical trivia. Distinct normalized space from earlier Dirichlet analogue makes its precise constant independently useful.
